description: This file defines the ACLController class for managing access control logic in a SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for checking user access, filtering modules based on permissions, and handling access-related UI behaviors.

classes.name: ACLController
classes.description: Controller class providing ACL management functions for SuiteCRM modules including access checks, module filtering, and UI integrations.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Determines if the current user has access to a specific category/action, including special cases for reports, products, invoices, calendar, and activities.

methods.name: requireOwner
methods.description: Checks if the user needs ownership rights for a given category.

methods.name: requireSecurityGroup
methods.description: Checks if the user requires a security group for a given category.

methods.name: filterModuleList
methods.description: Filters a list of modules based on the current user's permissions.

methods.name: checkModuleAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific module is enabled/accessible for the current user.

methods.name: disabledModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of modules disabled for the current user based on their permissions.

methods.name: addJavascript
methods.description: Injects JavaScript for ACL-related UI functionality.

methods.name: moduleSupportsACL
methods.description: Determines if a module supports ACL by checking if its bean class implements ACL.

methods.name: displayNoAccess
methods.description: Displays an 'access denied' message and optionally redirects to the home page.
